    # custom loop without clip interference, 50000 max

import numpy as np, warnings
from nn import NeuralNetwork
warnings.filterwarnings('error')
np.random.seed(0)
nn=NeuralNetwork(2,16,1)
# extreme forward
for z in [np.array([[1000.,-1000.]]), np.array([[1e6,-1e6]]), np.random.randn(10,2)*100]:
    try:
        o=nn.sigmoid(z)
        assert np.all(np.isfinite(o)), f"non-finite sigmoid {o}"
        assert np.all((o>=0)&(o<=1))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL sigmoid {e}"); raise
print("sigmoid extreme OK")
# forward/backward stability on train data
X=np.load('/app/X_train.npy'); y=np.load('/app/y_train.npy')
for i in range(5):
    o=nn.forward(X)
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(o))
    nn.backward(X,y,o)
    assert all(np.all(np.isfinite(w)) for w in [nn.W1,nn.W2,nn.b1,nn.b2])
print("forward/backward finite OK")
# predict/forward contract
assert set(np.unique(nn.predict(X))).issubset({0,1})
assert np.all((nn.forward(X)>=0)&(nn.forward(X)<=1))
print("API contract OK")
